originality.rationale: A same-source previous perimeter-deficit theorem uses the same gap limit but does not imply this complete normalized area-variance range and non-equiangular equality classification. Primary full-text comparisons separate same-model mean-volume order (Reitzner–Schütt–Werner), same-object Hausdorff loss (Prochno et al.), smooth-body boundary sampling (Schütt–Werner), and interior polygon hulls (Groeneboom). The explicit entire planar area-loss distribution and the finite cumulant angular sine-spectrum claim are not implied by their inspected statements. Residual unlocated priority is openly acknowledged.
residual_risks: The gap limit resembles a known perimeter-deficit law; value depends crucially on the newly established full area-fluctuation extremal interval and equality classification.
